name: retention-paraphrase-v1
selection: all 16 already inspected questions, no sampling

Which Jamaican snapper dish with fruit did you suggest to me?

Which game had I managed to finish by last weekend?
Where did I give a poster presentation about my thesis?

In what sequence did I watch the January sports events?
